messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@stratuscloud.io>; CloudBridge Marketplace <marketplace@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Embedded seller SKU governance + Co-sell pathway (StratusCloud listing)

Hi Samantha / CloudBridge team,

Thanks again for the intro last week. As discussed, StratusCloud will be embedding Redwood inference capabilities into their managed product and we want to get a clean path for listing + co-sell qualification on CloudBridge. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm which SKUs will be customer-facing on the marketplace (metered vs. flat SKU).
- Agree on co-sell eligibility criteria (trial usage thresholds, sales motion handoffs).
- Evidence we need for co-sell certification (SAML integration, SOC attestation, telemetry hooks).

Attached I’ve dropped an initial onboarding matrix and a draft term sheet to help scope. Ben / Olga / Vivek — looping you in for technical/telemetry and evidence questions.

Desired timeline: listing draft by next Wednesday (5/25) so procurement can start review at Stratus the week after. Can we confirm an intake window and owner on CloudBridge’s side?

Thanks,

Rohan Mehta
Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood-stratus-onboarding-matrix.xlsx, co-sell-term-sheet-v1.pdf

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@stratuscloud.io>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, CloudBridge Marketplace <marketplace@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embedded seller SKU governance + Co-sell pathway (StratusCloud listing)

Hi Rohan — great summary, thanks. Quick answers from our side:

- We intend to expose two SKUs initially: "Stratus + Redwood On-Demand" (metered token-based) and "Stratus-Redwood Reserved" (monthly).
- Procurement at ACME (copied) needs the term sheet and a simple SLA matrix; they’ll kick off legal review once we have the draft listing page.
- For co-sell, CloudBridge requires a telemetry contract that sends anonymized usage signals and a certified listing checklist (they’ve flagged SSO + billing reconciliation as must-haves).

We can own the Stratus-side intake and provide a first-pass listing description by 5/24, but we’ll need two things from Redwood:
1) A short description of the metering metric and sample invoice mapping;
2) The evidence checklist (SOC2 summary, SSO doc) — if you can drop that in Drive that would help.

Samantha Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, StratusCloud
Samantha.ortiz@stratuscloud.io

Date: 2027-05-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embedded seller SKU governance + Co-sell pathway (StratusCloud listing)

Adding a couple of technical constraints / proposals from infra:

- Metering metric: we recommend a tokens-per-request metric for the On-Demand SKU with daily aggregation. This maps cleanly to our existing billing pipeline and CloudBridge metering adapter.
- Billing reconciliation: CloudBridge will want a nightly CSV export with invoice keys. We can add that export but it will be behind a role-based access control (RBAC) flag; Stratus will need an integration user.
- Telemetry: to satisfy co-sell rules, we can publish a lightweight "co-sell signal" endpoint that emits: listing_id, anonymized_customer_id, usage_bucket (0/low/medium/high). No PII.

Open questions for CloudBridge: is a nightly export sufficient for marketplace reporting, or do you need near real-time streaming for entitlement checks?

Ben Carter
Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Embedded seller SKU governance + Co-sell pathway (StratusCloud listing)

Thanks — I pulled together an evidence checklist (attached) and a suggested minimal cert bundle for co-sell. Highlights:

- Required: SOC2 Type II summary (redacted), SSO SAML metadata, API sandbox for listing verification, and an endpoint for the co-sell signal described by Ben.
- Nice-to-have: perf benchmark for 95th percentile latency at the SKU config, and a test prompt set for quality gating.

I attached "marketplace-evidence-checklist.docx" and updated the onboarding matrix with fields for the RBAC user and export schema. Propose we drive a short triage call tomorrow (5/20) with CloudBridge intake and Stratus procurement to align evidence and timeline.

Olga Petrov
Director, Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

Great progress, team — thanks. Quick recap and agreed next steps:

1) SKUs: Stratus + Redwood On-Demand (metered) and Stratus-Redwood Reserved (monthly) — Stratus to share final naming by EOD 5/24.
2) Metering & billing: Ben to expose nightly invoice CSV export and example mapping; Stratus to provision integration user by 5/24.
3) Evidence: Olga’s checklist is sufficient for intake — Olga to upload the SOC2 redacted summary and SSO metadata to the Drive folder by EOD 5/21.
4) Co-sell signal: Ben will prototype the anonymized signal endpoint; CloudBridge to confirm whether nightly CSV is OK or requires streaming by 5/21.
5) Intake call: propose 5/21 10:00 AM PT for CloudBridge intake + Stratus procurement + Redwood triage (30 minutes).

Attachments (final): redwood-stratus-onboarding-matrix.xlsx, co-sell-term-sheet-v1.pdf, marketplace-evidence-checklist.docx

If there are no blockers I’ll schedule the 5/21 call and update the HubSpot deal record (HS-48291).
